title: Alibaba launches agentic AI tool to help SMEs expand
desc: Alibaba.com, the firm's business-to-business arm, has launched its agentic artificial intelligence (AI) tool Accio in Thailand to help small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) expand exports, as demand from European and Southeast Asian buyers creates new opportunities for Thai suppliers.
title_cn: 阿里巴巴在泰推出智能 AI 工具助力中小企业拓展出口
summary_cn: 阿里巴巴国际站（Alibaba.com）正式在泰国推出智能代理 AI 工具 Accio，这是其全球化战略中的重要一步。该平台专为中小企业（SMEs）设计，致力于抓住欧洲及东南亚买家需求增长的机遇。通过 AI 赋能帮助泰国供应商精准对接国际市场、扩大出口规模，是数字贸易赋能本地企业的重要举措，也反映出泰国在全球贸易中地位上升。
desc_original: Alibaba.com, the firm's business-to-business arm, has launched its agentic artificial intelligence (AI) tool Accio in Thailand to help small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) expand exports, as demand from European and Southeast Asian buyers creates new opportunities for Thai suppliers.

title: One Map plan to boost response
desc: The government will develop a nationwide "One Map of Water" to create a shared database for monitoring floods and other water-related disasters and improve emergency response.
title_cn: 泰国推出「一张水灾图」计划，强化灾害应对能力
summary_cn: 泰国政府计划开发全国统一的「一张水灾图」平台，构建水灾及相关水文灾害监测的共享数据库。通过整合气象、水资源等多部门数据，建立实时监测和预警机制。这项举措有助于大幅提升紧急响应速度、改进灾害预警精度，是泰国应对洪涝频发挑战的重要基础设施建设，意义重大。
desc_original: The government will develop a nationwide "One Map of Water" to create a shared database for monitoring floods and other water-related disasters and improve emergency response.

title: EIC downplays political risk for the local economy
desc: Following the Election Commission's (EC) recent resolution on the alleged Senate election collusion case, SCB Economic Intelligence Center (EIC), the research arm of Siam Commercial Bank, expects political factors to have a limited impact on the Thai economy through the rest of this year.
title_cn: 泰国经济智库下调政治风险，预期全年影响有限
summary_cn: 泰国选举委员会（EC）就参议院选举串联案做出决议后，暹罗商业银行（SCB）属下经济情报中心（EIC）发表乐观观点：预计政治因素对泰国经济今年余下时期的冲击将受限。这项评估反映市场对泰国政治局势逐步稳定的乐观预期。政治风险下降将有利于提振商业信心、吸引外资、维持经济增长势头，是泰国经济前景的积极信号。
desc_original: Following the Election Commission's (EC) recent resolution on the alleged Senate election collusion case, SCB Economic Intelligence Center (EIC), the research arm of Siam Commercial Bank, expects political factors to have a limited impact on the Thai economy through the rest of this year.

title: Revived Mice sector valued at B200bn
desc: Thailand's Mice (meetings, incentives, conventions and exhibitions) sector is steadily transitioning into recovery mode and is expected to be worth 200 billion baht this year.
title_cn: 泰国 MICE 产业复苏，年度市场规模达 200 亿泰铢
summary_cn: 泰国会议展览业（MICE：Meetings, Incentives, Conventions and Exhibitions）正稳步进入复苏期，预期今年市场规模达 200 亿泰铢（Baht）。在后疫情时代国际商务往来恢复、企业商务活动需求回升的背景下，该行业展现强劲增长势头。MICE 产业是泰国服务业的支柱产业，其复苏成为推动整体经济恢复的重要驱动力，发展前景看好。
desc_original: Thailand's Mice (meetings, incentives, conventions and exhibitions) sector is steadily transitioning into recovery mode and is expected to be worth 200 billion baht this year.

title: Cause for cheer in Thai PISA results

title: New centre to combat invasive fish
desc: Agriculture and Cooperatives Minister Suriya Juangroongruangkit has established a centre to coordinate efforts to combat the spread of blackchin tilapia, calling the invasive species a national concern and promising visible results within three months.

desc_original: Agriculture and Cooperatives Minister Suriya Juangroongruangkit has established a centre to coordinate efforts to combat the spread of blackchin tilapia, calling the invasive species a national concern and promising visible results within three months.

desc_original: Thailand is being urged to mount a concerted effort involving the government, academia, private sector, local authorities and the public to tackle the country's low birth rate crisis, covering the entire lifecycle from having and raising children to preparing them for work.

title: National Telecom, USTDA ink feasibility study pact
desc: State enterprise National Telecom (NT) and the US Trade and Development Agency (USTDA) have signed a grant agreement to support a feasibility study for the new Thailand–US (THUS) international submarine cable system, aiming to strengthen Thailand's position as a regional digital connectivity hub.
title_cn: 国家电信与美国贸易署签署可行性研究协议
summary_cn: 泰国国营企业国家电信公司（National Telecom）与美国贸易和发展署（USTDA）签署赠款协议，共同支持泰美（THUS）国际海底光缆系统的可行性研究。该项目旨在强化泰国作为区域数字连接枢纽的战略地位。
desc_original: State enterprise National Telecom (NT) and the US Trade and Development Agency (USTDA) have signed a grant agreement to support a feasibility study for the new Thailand–US (THUS) international submarine cable system, aiming to strengthen Thailand's position as a regional digital connectivity hub.

title: Data centre rules near completion
desc: The government expects to finalise a framework and minimum standards for data centres within a month, focusing on preventing projects from affecting surrounding communities, National Economic and Social Development Council (NESDC) secretary-general Danucha Pichayanan said on Tuesday.
title_cn: 数据中心管理办法月内敲定
summary_cn: 泰国政府由国家经济和社会发展委员会(NESDC)主导，预计一个月内完成数据中心框架和最低标准，重点防止项目对周边社区的影响。
desc_original: The government expects to finalise a framework and minimum standards for data centres within a month, focusing on preventing projects from affecting surrounding communities, National Economic and Social Development Council (NESDC) secretary-general Danucha Pichayanan said on Tuesday.

title: Cabinet backs national disaster insurance scheme
desc: The cabinet has approved a national insurance scheme providing disaster coverage for about 30 million households from Oct 1, in a move aimed at speeding up compensation and cutting state relief costs.
title_cn: 政府推出全国灾难保险方案
summary_cn: 泰国内阁批准全国灾难保险方案，自10月1日起向约3000万户家庭提供灾难保险覆盖，旨在加快灾难赔偿速度并减少政府救灾开支。
desc_original: The cabinet has approved a national insurance scheme providing disaster coverage for about 30 million households from Oct 1, in a move aimed at speeding up compensation and cutting state relief costs.

title: B95bn irrigation project gets nod
desc: A six-year irrigation project worth 95 billion baht has been approved to improve flood management in the lower eastern Chao Phraya basin and protect communities and economic areas across eight provinces, including Bangkok, said the government.
title_cn: 95亿泰铢灌溉项目获批
summary_cn: 泰国政府批准耗资95亿泰铢、历时六年的灌溉项目，重点改善湄南河(Chao Phraya)下游盆地洪水管理，保护曼谷及周边七省的社区和经济区域。
desc_original: A six-year irrigation project worth 95 billion baht has been approved to improve flood management in the lower eastern Chao Phraya basin and protect communities and economic areas across eight provinces, including Bangkok, said the government.

title: CIB uncovers ex-abbot's millions
desc: The Central Investigation Bureau (CIB) has uncovered more than 300 million baht in bank accounts linked to former Wat Phutthaisawan abbot Atichot Tanprasert and his close female associate as it widens its probe into suspected financial misconduct.
title_cn: 中调局查获前普陀寺方丈3亿泰铢资产
summary_cn: 泰国中央调查局在调查前普陀寺(Wat Phutthaisawan)方丈阿迪乔·坦帕瑟特涉嫌财务不当行为案件中，发现其名下及其女性关联人控制的银行账户中有超过3亿泰铢资金。
desc_original: The Central Investigation Bureau (CIB) has uncovered more than 300 million baht in bank accounts linked to former Wat Phutthaisawan abbot Atichot Tanprasert and his close female associate as it widens its probe into suspected financial misconduct.

title: SEC proposes changes to stablecoin transfer rules
desc: The Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) is tightening oversight of stablecoin transfers, proposing a 5-million-baht cap as it moves to crack down on money laundering, cybercrime and attempts to use digital assets to circumvent international money transfer rules.
title_cn: 泰证交所拟限制稳定币转账额度
summary_cn: 泰国证券交易委员会收紧稳定币转账监管，提议设立500万泰铢转账上限，目标打击洗钱、网络犯罪，并防止利用数字资产规避国际汇款规则。
desc_original: The Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) is tightening oversight of stablecoin transfers, proposing a 5-million-baht cap as it moves to crack down on money laundering, cybercrime and attempts to use digital assets to circumvent international money transfer rules.

title: Private equity trust offers funding for new tech firms
desc: Thailand is launching a 1-billion-baht private equity trust (PE Trust) to provide growth capital for new economy businesses, with the Stock Exchange of Thailand (SET) planning a pathway to bring promising firms to the bourse through the LiVE Exchange and Market for Alternative Investment (MAI).
title_cn: 泰国推出10亿泰铢私募基金信托扶持新兴科技企业
summary_cn: 泰国启动规模10亿泰铢的私募基金信托（PE Trust），为新经济企业提供成长资本。泰国证券交易所（SET）计划通过LiVE Exchange和另类投资市场（MAI）为优质初创企业提供登陆交易所的途径，促进新兴产业融资发展。
desc_original: Thailand is launching a 1-billion-baht private equity trust (PE Trust) to provide growth capital for new economy businesses, with the Stock Exchange of Thailand (SET) planning a pathway to bring promising firms to the bourse through the LiVE Exchange and Market for Alternative Investment (MAI).

title: Anutin files defamation lawsuit against iLaw chief
desc: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has filed a defamation lawsuit against iLaw director Yingcheep Atchanont over remarks linking him to alleged collusion in the 2024 Senate election, insisting the legal action is not intended to silence his critics.

desc_original: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has filed a defamation lawsuit against iLaw director Yingcheep Atchanont over remarks linking him to alleged collusion in the 2024 Senate election, insisting the legal action is not intended to silence his critics.

title: One Bangkok eyes 10% visitor increase
desc: One Bangkok Retail, part of One Bangkok's mixed-use development, is targeting a 10% increase in visitors in 2027, building on the 40 million visitors in its second year of operation.

desc_original: One Bangkok Retail, part of One Bangkok's mixed-use development, is targeting a 10% increase in visitors in 2027, building on the 40 million visitors in its second year of operation.

title: Use of banned ‘red meat’ chemicals in cattle uncovered
desc: Thai authorities have arrested a chemical supplier after finding salbutamol, a beta agonist used illegally as a “red meat” enhancer, in nearly 1,000 cattle in an eight-month investigation spanning five provinces.
title_cn: 泰国查获近千头牛群非法使用禁用瘦肉精
summary_cn: 泰国当局在历时8个月、涉及5个省份的调查中，发现近1000头牛群被非法注射沙丁胺醇（一种禁用的β-受体激动剂），用作「瘦肉精」以增加肉品品质。检方已逮捕涉案的化学品供应商。这一重大食品安全事件暴露了泰国畜牧业品质监管的严重漏洞，直接威胁消费者的健康安全。
desc_original: Thai authorities have arrested a chemical supplier after finding salbutamol, a beta agonist used illegally as a “red meat” enhancer, in nearly 1,000 cattle in an eight-month investigation spanning five provinces.

title: AC condensation, undersized screws caused parliament ceiling collapse
desc: Water dripping from air conditioning ducts and undersized screws used in ceiling panels caused the ceiling of the cafeteria at the parliament complex in Bangkok to collapse on Sunday, an inspection has found.
title_cn: 空调冷凝水与螺丝规格不符致议会自助餐厅天花板坍塌
summary_cn: 曼谷议会大楼自助餐厅天花板周日突然坍塌，经官方检查发现事故原因为两大因素：一是空调管道冷凝水长期渗漏，二是天花板面板安装所用螺丝规格不符合标准。该事件反映出议会设施建筑质量与日常维护管理的问题，可能引发对政府建筑维护体系和安全标准的进一步审视和改进。
desc_original: Water dripping from air conditioning ducts and undersized screws used in ceiling panels caused the ceiling of the cafeteria at the parliament complex in Bangkok to collapse on Sunday, an inspection has found.

title: 泰国严管“减肥针”！今天起须凭医生处方购买
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 泰国食品药品监督管理局（FDA）宣布，自2026年9月15日起，GLP-1类注射药物正式列为“特殊管制药物”。民众购买包括利拉鲁肽、司美格鲁肽在内的GLP-1注射药物，必须持有医生处方，并由药剂师负责配发。 FDA秘书长苏帕特拉·汶森表示，GLP-1受体激动剂主要用于治疗2型糖尿病，部分药物也获准用于肥胖患者的体重管理。近期发现，有人在未经医生评估和指导的情况下将其用于减重，同时市场上还出现假药、来源不明药品及通过网络非法销售等问题。为此，泰国卫生部出台《特殊管制药物》第58号公告，加强对该类药物的监管。 新规实施后，药房销售GLP-1注射药物必须凭医生处方，由药剂师审核并交付。FDA还将通过Track & Trace药品追踪系统加强监管，逐步追踪药品从进口、储存、流通到最终交付患者的全过程，以防止药品流入非法渠道，并及时发现假药及未经注册药品。 FDA提醒，无处方销售特殊管制药物、无证售药或销售未经注册药品，均可能面临监禁及罚款；违法进行药品广告宣传，最高可罚10万泰铢。目前，FDA正在进一步制定药品销售和流通的具体标准。 FDA强调，新措施不会影响真正有医疗需求的患者正常用药。经医生诊断并在医生指导下使用GLP-1药物的患者，仍可正常获得药物，同时药品来源和流通渠道将更加透明，进一步提高用药安全。 民众购买GLP-1药物后，可通过泰国FDA官网的Track & Trace产品序列化追踪系统，输入药品包装上的Serial Number，查询该药品是否获得许可。若查询不到相关信息，或网站信息与药品包装不符，应立即停止使用，并拨打FDA热线1556或通过Oryor Smart Application举报。相关渠道全天候开放。 （编译：Wan；来源：泰国食品药品监督管理局） The post 泰国严管“减肥针”！今天起须凭医生处方购买 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .

title: Thailand pushes Doi Inthanon for ASEAN heritage status
desc: Thailand pushes Doi Inthanon for ASEAN heritage status Legacy Thailand is seeking ASEAN Heritage Park status for Doi Inthanon National Park in Chiang Mai, with regional biodiversity experts due to assess the site from September 16 to 18. Deputy Government Spokesperson Lalida Persvivatana said today, September 15, that the government was advancing the nomination to strengthen conservation of natural resources and biodiversity while supporting ecotourism and local economies. Photo via Thaigov The Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment submitted the proposal for Cabinet consideration after the national biodiversity committee approved the nomination on May 6. The next step will be an on-site assessment by experts from the ASEAN Centre for Biodiversity (ACB). Doi Inthanon National Park covers about 296,922.22 rai across parts of Chom Thong, Mae Chaem, Mae Wang and Doi Lo districts in Chiang Mai. Natural forest accounts for 89.5% of the park, which also contains important headwaters of the Ping River , part of the wider Chao Phraya River basin. desc: The Tuna Truth documentary trailer released after first Asian screening in Bangkok Legacy The trailer for The Tuna Truth documentary , a new ocean sustainability film directed by Sara Pipernos of Sunline Films and commissioned by the International Pole & Line Foundation, or IPNLF, has been released following the documentary’s first screening in Asia. The private screening was held at Blue Elephant Bangkok Sukhumvit to coincide with TUNA 2026, the major international tuna industry gathering taking place in Bangkok from September 14 to 16, 2026. title: Chinese woman held after escaping six-year prison sentence in China
desc: Chinese woman held after escaping six-year prison sentence in China Legacy Thai police arrested a Chinese woman at Suvarnabhumi International Airport on September 13 after she evaded a six-year prison sentence in China for procuring prostitution . The Crime Suppression Division of the Central Investigation Bureau (CIB) announced the arrest of the 32 year old woman, identified as Wang, on September 14. According to the CIB, Wang was prosecuted by the Nanning Public Security Bureau for procuring prostitution. She was initially granted temporary bail after becoming pregnant. On December 2, 2025, the Xixiangtang District People’s Court sentenced Wang to six years in prison and fined her 500,000 yuan. title: 泰警捣毁一笑气生产窝点，10余名中国及缅甸籍嫌犯被捕
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 9月14日，泰国曼谷京畿警察署调查小组、曼谷京畿警察署第四分署联合食品药品监督管理局（FDA），依法捣毁一涉嫌非法生产“笑气”的工厂和仓库，当场逮捕多名中国籍和缅甸籍涉案人员，查扣违禁物品一批，包括1,600余瓶“笑气”成品和半成品。据悉，调查人员此前接报称，曼谷Prawet区有一家未注册的隐蔽工厂，私自从事一氧化二氮（N₂O，俗称“笑气”）的灌装业务，并在未经许可的情况下向社会出售。 警方经现场查证后确认，上述工厂在未取得合法资质的情况下，私自灌装并销售“笑气”，并通过第三方快递物流渠道向买家发货。该厂区由中国籍人员负责管理和统筹，10名缅甸籍非法劳工负责日常生产，并居住在厂内。 本次查扣的涉案物资如下： 1. 已装瓶待售的“笑气”共1,652瓶； 2. 容量为48.6公斤的蓝色一氧化二氮（N₂O）气瓶，共5瓶； 3. 用于灌装的空气瓶，共4,200瓶； 4. 重达36,000公斤的一氧化二氮（N₂O）槽罐挂车，共2辆； 5. 气体灌装机、充气机及气压调节设备一批； 6. 用于运输货物的皮卡车及货车，共2辆。 曼谷京畿警察署调查小组提醒民众，私自生产、进口及销售“笑气（一氧化二氮）并滥用于非法用途，如灌入气球吸食以获取快感、致幻、麻痹神经或替代毒品者，将被依法追究刑事责任，涉案人员或被指控“未经许可销售药品”，最高可处以5年有期徒刑，并处以最高10,000泰铢罚款。 （编译：KA；来源：bangkokbiznews） The post 泰警捣毁一笑气生产窝点，10余名中国及缅甸籍嫌犯被捕 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .

title: 泰国启动外国人入籍核查，拟修法封堵漏洞
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 9月14日，泰国内政部副部长蓬拉里主持召开了社会秩序特别行动组会议，旨在跟进当月工作进展，内政部副部长沃拉实共同出席。在本次会议中，蓬拉里要求有关部门彻底梳理入籍申请制度，从步骤、标准到审批流程全面重新审视，并回溯核查过去一年内已获得泰国国籍的个案细节，以修订1965版《国籍法》，使其更契合当前形势，并封堵漏洞，保护泰国人的权利。 此前，特别行动组在全国范围内排查社会秩序问题，尤其是外国人通过泰国人挂名（即“代持人”）持有资产或从事商业活动等情况，过程中发现，不少案件与已获得泰国国籍的外国人有关，所以需要重新检视现行入籍流程和标准，确定是否存在被利用来谋利或规避法律限制的漏洞。 蓬拉里强调，有关部门必须仔细核查现有流程，认真审视入籍标准，让法律修订能够更严密、更贴合实际，其核心目标是切实保护泰国人民的权利和利益。另外，内政部应加快向各府市、各县镇、各村社的官员普及移民法知识，敦促行政人员和当地民众一起留意、及时举报。对于外国人索取泰国人的身份证或个人信息的行为应特别警惕，以防其用来冒名注册公司，色军府和那空帕侬府之前就发生过类似情况，最终可能导致泰国人被利用充当“代持人”，帮助外国人规避泰国法律限制。 （编译：KA；来源：ch7） The post 泰国启动外国人入籍核查，拟修法封堵漏洞 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .

title: 关于调整泰国免签政策通知
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 鉴于泰国免签政策的最新调整，包括取消60天免签政策以及对30天免签和落地签（VoA）政策的调整，自2026年9月15日起，中华人民共和国与蒙古国的普通护照持有人可继续依据泰国与两国签署的双边签证免签协定入境泰国。相关政策内容如下： 中国公民：持有中华人民共和国普通护照及公务普通护照人员，可根据泰国与中华人民共和国之间签订的双边协定免签入境泰国，单次停留期最长不超过30天。 蒙古国公民：持有蒙古国普通护照人员，可根据泰国与蒙古国之间签订的双边协定免签入境泰国，单次停留期最长不超过30天。 (1) 如需申请泰国电子签证，请访问泰国官方电子签证网站（www.thaievisa.go.th）。 (2) 有关停留期延期事宜，须在合法停留期限内直接向泰国当地移民局提交申请，由移民局根据个人具体情况进行审理。如需办理延期停留，请直接联系泰国当地移民局以获取更多信息 （www.immigration.go.th）。 （来源：泰王国驻华大使馆） The post 关于调整泰国免签政策通知 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .

summary_cn: 泰国宣布重大签证政策调整，自2026年9月15日起生效。取消原有的60天免签政策，中国及蒙古国普通护照持有人仍可根据双边协议继续享受单次最长30天的免签入境泰国待遇。中国游客和旅居人士需关注新规定。如需延长停留期限，须在当地移民局办理。申请电子签证（e-Visa）的游客可登录泰国官方电子签证网站办理。
